summary: Tested all 11 requested features for iteration 11 (Reading Streak System, Advanced Search, Admin Audit Log, DOCX upload, Book Card Consistency, UI Refinements). Backend: 20/20 pytest cases passed covering /api/reading-streak (GET, auth, unauth), /api/reading-stats, /api/reading-session (log + streak increments), /api/reading-streak/goal (valid + invalid range), /api/admin/audit-logs (with/without filter, unauth), /api/admin/audit-logs/actions + /stats, /api/search/books (basic, filtered, sort_by=title, missing q, unauth), /api/search/categories, /api/books/{id}/upload-docx (unauth, invalid book 404, invalid extension 400). Frontend: Library page shows Streak nav button (data-testid='nav-streak') that toggles the full ReadingStreakDashboard (verified 1 Current / 1 Longest / 1 Total days, Weekly Reading Goal with day badges, Reading Statistics with Books Read/Pages/Time/Favorite Category). Compact ReadingStreakDashboard shown on mobile (390x844) under md:hidden. Search input in library nav opens AdvancedSearch modal (data-testid='search-input') with 4 filter selects (category, tier, file-type, sort_by) via filter-toggle. Admin Dashboard shows Activity tab (data-testid='tab-activity') that renders AdminAuditLog with Filters button and empty state 'No activity logs found' (audit_logs collection is currently empty, backend returns {logs:[],total:0}). Admin Books tab shows DOCX upload label/button next to Upload PDF for every book row (46 books, 46 DOCX buttons present).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 4251 lines (grew from 3663). Should be split into modules (auth/, books/, subscriptions/, admin/, reading/, search/) for maintainability. Not blocking.

ReadingStreakDashboard fetches /reading-streak and /reading-stats on every mount. Since both compact (mobile) and full (desktop toggled) instances mount simultaneously (compact stays in DOM as md:hidden), each instance duplicates the fetch. Consider lifting state to LibraryPage or using a shared context/cache to avoid 4 API calls per Library visit.
advanced_book_search default sort_by='relevance' sorts by tier_level ASC which is misleading (it's not real relevance). Consider MongoDB $text index with $meta:'textScore' for true relevance ranking.
AdvancedSearch modal auto-fires performSearch on every filter change but only when debouncedQuery >= 2 chars. Initial modal opens with no query, showing 'Start typing to search'. Good UX.

AdminAuditLog uses log.log_id as key but audit log entries may not have log_id field (server.py log_admin_action likely uses timestamp+admin_email). Fallback to index i is OK but could cause React re-render inefficiency.
/api/reading-streak/goal accepts goal_days as QUERY parameter via `goal_days: int` on PUT. Frontend correctly passes it as query string. Would be cleaner as JSON body for a PUT endpoint but works.
get_reading_stats always returns 200 with empty defaults if no sessions — good behavior, no 404s for new users.
upload_docx endpoint validates .docx/.doc extension but does NOT validate file MIME type/content. A user could rename .exe to .docx and upload; consider adding python-magic MIME check.
Advanced Search modal is fixed inset-0 z-50 which overlays entire viewport. On desktop it hides the library nav; consider a smaller modal for desktop UX. Acceptable for mobile-first design.
Reading Streak Dashboard skeleton (loading state) does NOT have data-testid, making it hard to detect loading state in tests. Consider adding data-testid='reading-streak-loading' to skeleton wrapper.
Admin Audit Log tab loading skeleton takes 4-8s in one instance because /admin loads dashboard stats sequentially. Consider parallel loading or lazy-loading tabs.
seed_data_creation: Logged 1 reading session for admin during backend test (book_id from existing books list). This created a reading_streaks doc showing current_streak=1, longest_streak=1, total_reading_days=1. Reading goal was updated to 5 days as part of test_update_reading_goal_valid. No audit log entries exist in DB (admin_audit_logs collection is empty) - all admin action tests trigger log writes but historical actions predate the audit logging.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 requested features are working correctly. Endpoints verified: (1) GET /api/reading-streak returns {current_streak, longest_streak, total_reading_days, last_read_date, reading_goal_days, goal_progress}. (2) GET /api/reading-stats returns {total_books_read, total_pages_read, total_reading_time_minutes, favorite_category, books_by_month, reading_history}. (3) POST /api/reading-session with body {book_id, pages_read, reading_time_minutes, current_page} logs session AND updates streak AND upserts reading_progress. (4) PUT /api/reading-streak/goal?goal_days=N (1<=N<=7). (5) GET /api/admin/audit-logs with filters {limit, offset, action, target_type, admin_email} + /actions + /stats sub-endpoints. (6) GET /api/search/books?q=<query> with filters (category, tier, file_type, sort_by) returns {books:[{...,accessible:bool}], total, query}. Default sort_by='relevance' sorts by tier_level ASC. (7) GET /api/search/categories is UNAUTHENTICATED (no auth needed - good for search modal). (8) POST /api/books/{id}/upload-docx requires admin, validates .docx/.doc extension, stores at darussalam-kitab/documents/{book_id}.docx, updates book.docx_url and book.file_type='docx'. Frontend testids: 'nav-streak' (Streak toggle button in library nav), 'reading-streak-dashboard' (full dashboard container), 'search-input' (advanced search input inside modal), 'filter-toggle' (filter panel toggle in AdvancedSearch), 'book-search-input' (library nav search input that opens modal), 'tab-activity' (admin activity tab), 'tab-books' (admin books tab). IMPORTANT: Reading streak dashboard fetch takes 4-5 seconds after clicking Streak button before content appears (need to wait for API); use wait_for_selector on 'reading-streak-dashboard' with 10s timeout. Admin Dashboard initial load can take 5-10s due to sequential loading of stats/tabs.

rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in this iteration. Only observation: the ReadingStreakDashboard toggle takes 4-5 seconds after clicking the Streak button because the component mounts fresh with loading=true and fetches /reading-streak + /reading-stats. During that window only the animate-pulse skeleton (no data-testid) is in the DOM, which can cause tests using short timeouts to falsely report 'not found'. Recommend adding data-testid='reading-streak-loading' to the skeleton for better testability.
